detail.longDescription:
Google Wallet is a secure, private app that connects with Gmail and your other Google apps to bring your orders, receipts, boarding passes, tickets, and loyalty cards together. It automatically tracks delivery and travel updates, saving you time and keeping everything organized in one place. Saved payment methods let you breeze through checkout online and across Google. In-store tap-to-pay is not supported on iOS at this time.

Key Features:
Always in Sync
• Pull up delivery statuses and travel details on any device where you're signed in to your Google Account.

Find Orders in Seconds
• Wallet gathers receipts and shipping updates from Gmail, so you can check any delivery without opening the retailer's app.

Scan Physical Cards and Barcodes
• Easily digitize physical loyalty cards, gym memberships, and barcode passes using your iPhone camera.

Tickets and Loyalty Cards, Ready When You Need Them
• Boarding passes, concert tickets, and loyalty cards from your inbox are organized and ready to show.

Safe and Private
• Your order history, personal data, and payment details are protected by Google's security and privacy controls. You choose what Wallet imports from Gmail.

Faster Online Checkout
• Securely manage your saved payment methods in one place, so you can breeze through purchases online and across Google.

(Note: In-store tap-to-pay is not supported on iOS. Google Wallet on iPhone is designed for automated package tracking, managing passes, tickets, and loyalty cards, and fast online checkout.)
